sources.title: allenai/tulu-2-dpo-7b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tulu is a series of language models that are trained to act as helpful assistants. Tulu V2 DPO 7B is a fine-tuned version of Llama 2 that was trained on on a mix of publicly available, synthetic and human datasets using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). This model is a strong alternative to Llama 2 7b Chat.
